item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `CalendarEvent(BaseModel)` with nested `participants` data and uses `event_info: CalendarEvent` in both the tool function and `InvitationSignature` input."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM` to script one JSON-shaped tool call, then `finish` with `{}`, then a final extraction response, and runs it through `dspy.ReAct`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Captures `type(event_info).__name__` inside the tool and asserts `seen_types == [\"CalendarEvent\"]`, explicitly showing the live call received a parsed model."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"0.5","rationale":"It asserts `result.trajectory[\"tool_args_0\"]` preserves the LM-emitted nested dict, but it does not explicitly assert that the trajectory records the later `finish` step."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Checks the final `invitation_letter` and prints both the tool-side type evidence and `result.trajectory[\"tool_args_0\"]`, making the model-vs-dict distinction visible."}],"question_score":90,"needs_regrade":false}
